fields.helpfullinkDescription:
Are you having problems with your medical care or Molina services? If so, you have a right to file a complaint (grievance) or appeal.

Common reasons for submitting a grievance or appeal include (but are not limited to); dissatisfaction with the care you received from a provider, challenges in finding providers, a desire to receive care or services not currently covered by your plan, or the denial of payment or authorization for a service.

Should you need to file a grievance or appeal, we will provide you with help through each step.
